Prompts

```
['run video object segmentation inference on a directory of videos using SAM 2 with input masks', 'run per-object VOS inference on videos where objects appear later than the first frame', 'run VOS inference using all available input masks instead of only the first frame mask', 'review the vos_inference function that propagates segmentation masks throughout a video using SAM 2 predictor', 'review the vos_separate_inference_per_object function that tracks objects independently across video frames']
```

